feed_control_tip:
Dear Customer,
To facilitate the activation of the feature enabling direct power discharge from your electricity storage system to the grid, we kindly request your confirmation of the following:
1. Your installation address is situated within the jurisdiction of {country};
2. You possess a current, legally binding agreement with your local grid company as a prerequisite for enabling the direct discharge of power from your electricity storage system and/or photovoltaic system into the grid.
Non-compliance with the above conditions may lead to safety hazards and potential legal entanglements, for which you will bear full responsibility. If you do not meet all the above conditions, you should not confirm and will not be able to use the feature to enable the direct power discharge from your electricity storage system to the grid.
Your attention to and cooperation with the above prerequisites is greatly appreciated.
